content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"a user with tasks in my personal task list","i_want":"a Task Reporting page that shows a table of all my tasks and the metrics Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks","so_that":"I can see the state of my workload at a glance without reviewing the task list one item at a time","business_description":"The Task Reporting page gives an aggregated view of the user's tasks. It shows every task in a table and three metrics: Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks. The metric values come from a backend report endpoint that aggregates the user's tasks.","business_value":"Users get one overview of their task status and totals, which supports planning without opening each task.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"the user has 5 tasks, 2 with status Open and 3 with status Completed","when":"the user opens the Task Reporting page","then":"the page shows Total Tasks 5, Open Tasks 2 and Completed Tasks 3"},{"given":"the user has 3 tasks in the task list","when":"the user opens the Task Reporting page","then":"the table shows exactly 3 rows, one for each of the user's tasks"},{"given":"the user has no tasks","when":"the user opens the Task Reporting page","then":"Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks each show 0 and the table has no task rows"},{"given":"the user has tasks in several statuses","when":"the report metrics endpoint is requested by that user","then":"the response contains the integer fields total_tasks, open_tasks and completed_tasks, computed over all of that user's tasks"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD lists the statuses Open, In Progress and Completed but does not say whether In Progress tasks count as Open Tasks. This is an open question. Until it is decided, Open Tasks counts only tasks with status Open.","The PRD does not state how the user is identified for the report. This story assumes the metrics and table cover only the signed-in user's tasks; the authentication approach is an open question.","Filtering, searching and sorting parameters are delivered by US-filter-search-sort-report. This story's metrics endpoint returns unfiltered totals across all of the user's tasks.","The PRD does not define loading, error or empty states for the Task Reporting page. This is an open question; the page must not show a success state for data that failed to load."],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["GET report metrics endpoint returns total_tasks, open_tasks and completed_tasks for the signed-in user","Metric values are computed from stored task status values and match the number of tasks in each status","Task Reporting page is reachable from navigation and shows the three metric values","Table on the Task Reporting page lists every task of the user, one row per task","Page calls the backend for data and does not display metric or table values that the backend has not returned","Open question about In Progress counting as Open is recorded in the story notes and confirmed by the product owner"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-metrics-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add GET report metrics endpoint returning total, open and completed task counts","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add a GET endpoint that returns total_tasks, open_tasks and completed_tasks for the signed-in user, computed from the existing task table. Open_tasks counts status Open only until the In Progress question is resolved.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint returns HTTP 200 with integer fields total_tasks, open_tasks and completed_tasks","Counts are computed from the status field of the user's tasks","Endpoint returns zeros when the user has no tasks","Errors follow the simple error handling approach used by the task endpoints"]},{"key_slug":"report-page-metrics","title":"[FE] Add Task Reporting page with Total, Open and Completed metric cards","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add the Task Reporting page route and navigation entry. Show Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks values fetched from the report metrics endpoint.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d0e0fe7a","R-4ffbfafa"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Task Reporting page is reachable from the application navigation","Three metrics labelled Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks are shown with values from the endpoint","Metric values are not shown until the endpoint responds successfully","Unit tests cover rendering of the three metric values"]},{"key_slug":"report-task-table","title":"[FE] Render all user tasks in a table on the Task Reporting page","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Show every task of the user in a table on the Task Reporting page, using the existing read-all tasks endpoint. Each row shows the task's stored fields such as title, status, priority and due date.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-a1b267a3"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Table shows one row per task returned by the read-all endpoint","Status and priority values are displayed as stored","Table is empty when the endpoint returns no tasks","Component tests cover a populated table and an empty table"]},{"key_slug":"report-view-test-suite","title":"[QA] Test suite for the Task Reporting page and report metrics endpoint","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated tests that verify the report metrics endpoint values and the Task Reporting page metrics and table against seeded task data.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":[],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests seed tasks in each status and assert the three metric values","Tests assert the table row count matches the seeded tasks","Tests cover the zero-task case for both the endpoint and the page","Test suite runs in the continuous integration pipeline and passes"]}]}
